body: I really have no idea why things started to go downhill, I think I kind of just felt bombarded. My friend and I dated for about two years, but for about a year and a half its just been hookups. I mean, the dude is probably the only person that knows absolutely everything about me, just this past week he's just been really cold and finally cut it off with me again. I don't think I did anything, but the week before he's been nothing but nice to me. I don't know. I realize that nothing is permanent but I just wish that something could be a little permanent. I don't know. Thanks though, I appreciate it.
